claims.text: The pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone (NEX Serangoon, Tower B ride-hail pickup, venue VEN-NEX-SERANGOON), so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m. The driver's own trace never enters it: the derived driver track reports min_distance_m, mean_distance_m and max_distance_m all at 219.77 m from the pin across 34 fixes, and the arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and 0 runs. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails — the trace does not place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 13:05:20 'arrived' event — and the SGD 4.00 fee is not chargeable on the baseline test.

The driver was stationary for the required dwell outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin, which is the precise case POL-NS-03 governs. The derived driver track runs 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30 (330 s) at a constant 219.77 m from the pin with a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h and no sampling gap, so he held position for longer than the LARGE_VENUE minimum of 300 s while never entering the 120 m radius and never exceeding the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. POL-NS-03 provides that such a driver did not arrive, limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. POL-NS-05 does not rescue the marker: the driver was stationary at 0 km/h and under 300 m from the pin, and POL-NS-05's own last sentence sends exactly this driver to POL-NS-03.

Independently of where he parked, the effective in-geofence dwell is zero: derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0, run_count is 0 and dwell_start_offset_sec is null, against the 300 s minimum dwell for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, and POL-NS-06 provides that where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short of the minimum the fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

Fault for the mislocation lies with the driver. The chat log shows the rider naming the correct sub-location twice — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — while the driver's only message places him at 'the mall taxi stand', and his own counterparty statement concedes he waited at a mall entrance 'but did not move to Tower B'. Under POL-NS-03(i) a driver who is told the correct entrance or tower in the chat log and does not move to it before cancelling bears the loss and receives no compensation, so no driver payment is due on this record and nothing is netted against the rider's refund.

The rider was in fact at the pickup. The derived rider track places her device 25.01 m from the pin for 16 of 16 qualifying fixes across 13:05:30 to 13:10:30, well inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, so the presence limb of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively satisfied rather than undecidable. The driver's 13:06:00 reply came 55 seconds after the rider's first locating message, so POL-NS-04's own closing direction applies and the residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03 — which refunds the fee in full. On either route the rider does not end up carrying the charge.

Nothing in POL-NS-08 impairs or caps the ruling. EV-GPS-09105 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 (34 fixes, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0, driver and rider tracks both present), the chat log's 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, the 13:05:20 'arrived' event sits on the 10 s fix grid, and the charged SGD 4.00 equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so the fare line reconciles under POL-NS-08(d). With the deciding fact carried by unimpaired evidence at weight 1.0, no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling applies under POL-NS-08 and no automatic escalation arises under POL-NS-09(a) or POL-NS-09(e); the case can be decided as a FULL_REFUND.

EV-ADVIS-09105-01 is impaired and MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload); its own record states that no traffic advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window. There is accordingly no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory covering this road, so the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals is unavailable on a MISSING artifact, and the driver has no advisory on which to excuse or supplement his dwell. The absence is itself citable and on this record it helps only the rider.

No profile ground and no escalation trigger supports holding this case. The citable no-show profile fields are the POL-NS-07 pair and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d under POL-NS-09(d): driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 (ratio 0.008), far below the 4-or-more AND greater-than-0.08 anti-farming test, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) does not fire either. The lifetime counters (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be substituted for the trailing-window fields.

The arrival marker at 13:05:20 is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05: at that moment the trace puts the driver 219.77 m from the pin, short of the 300 m trigger, and at 0.0 km/h, below the 15 km/h motion trigger set by POL-NS-05. No false-arrival finding and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral can attach to this driver.

The driver did not leave the rider's locating message unanswered: the rider's message was sent at 13:05:05 and the driver replied at 13:06:00, fifty-five seconds later and well inside the 120-second limit, so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 fails and the rider cannot be exonerated under that clause on the ground of driver silence.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (120) is 0.008, below 0.08. ruling.explanation: Both sides' accounts converge, and the record decides the case. The pickup was 'NEX Serangoon, Tower B ride-hail pickup' (venue VEN-NEX-SERANGOON), a LARGE_VENUE zone, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m and the POL-NS-01 minimum dwell is 300 seconds. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09105, weight 1.0, 34 fixes, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0) shows the driver holding a single constant position 219.77 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h for the whole 330-second window from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30. He never entered the 120 m arrival radius — the arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and 0 runs, and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0 against the 300 s minimum. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and limb (c) fails with it; the SGD 4.00 fee is not chargeable on the baseline test. Because the driver was nonetheless stationary for the required dwell at 219.77 m — outside the arrival radius but inside the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling — POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03, which refunds the cancellation fee to the rider in full. On fault for compensation: the chat log (EV-CHAT-09105, weight 1.0) shows the rider naming the correct sub-location at 13:05:05 ('I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign') and repeating 'Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35, while the driver's only message places him at 'the mall taxi stand'; the driver's own statement concedes he waited at a mall entrance 'but did not move to Tower B'. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation, so driver_compensation_sgd is null and nothing is netted against the rider's refund. I have weighed the remaining contentions. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at 13:05:20 the driver was 219.77 m from the pin (under the 300 m trigger) and at 0.0 km/h (under the 15 km/h trigger), so the arrival marker is not false and no POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral attaches — the advocates agree and the record confirms it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: her locating message was answered at 13:06:00, 55 seconds later and inside the 120-second window, so POL-NS-04's own closing direction applies and the residual mislocation goes to POL-NS-03, which refunds the fee in any event. The rider's independent POL-NS-06 route to the same outcome (zero effective in-geofence dwell) also holds; the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09105-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) removes only the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation option and is not held against either party. No POL-NS-08 limb is engaged: no clock skew (the 13:05:20 'arrived' event sits on the 10-second fix grid), no trace gap, a chat log whose 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, and a SGD 4.00 fee that equals the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00). No POL-NS-09 escalation limb fires: there is no direct contradiction on arrival, dwell or rider presence; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips, ratio 0.008). The lifetime counters (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld, rating) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and have carried no weight. The deciding facts are carried by unimpaired artifacts at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor. Ruling: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider is refunded in full; the driver receives no compensation.

Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 cancellation (no-show) fee charged to the rider is refunded in full.

Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — while the driver's only message placed him at 'the mall taxi stand', and his own counterparty statement concedes he waited at a mall entrance and 'did not move to Tower B'. Because the rider stated the correct tower and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation; the SGD 3.20 compensation figure shown in the fare breakdown is not paid.

The rider was in fact present (rider track 25.01 m from the pin across all 16 qualifying fixes, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius), but the driver replied at 13:06:00, 55 seconds after her first locating message, so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is not met and, per that clause's own closing direction, the residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03 — which gives the rider the full refund.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against 120 completed trips, ratio 0.008), and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire (disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 for both parties; no_show_disputes_30d 0). Profile fields such as rating, lifetime prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed and prior_disputes_upheld are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as grounds of decision. The deciding facts are carried by unimpaired artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-09105, corroborated by EV-CHAT-09105 and EV-TRIP-09105), so confidence is not capped below 1.0.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: I reviewed the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log, the fare breakdown, the two profiles and the traffic-advisory slot, and I have decided that the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. No driver compensation is payable. The SGD 4.00 figure is the fare breakdown's cancellation_fee and total_charged, and it matches the SGD 4.00 contested in the dispute.

The charge could only stand under POL-NS-01 if the driver's trace placed him inside the pickup geofence before he marked arrival and if he then held position inside that geofence for the zone's minimum dwell. NEX Serangoon, Tower B ride-hail pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone (venue VEN-NEX-SERANGOON), so the arrival radius is 120 m and the minimum dwell is 300 s. The driver's own trace is unambiguous: 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, every one at 219.77 m from the pin, every one at 0.0 km/h, 100% coverage and no sampling gap. He never entered the 120 m radius, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails; and the effective in-geofence dwell is zero against the 300 s minimum, so limb (c) fails as well. The fee is not chargeable on the baseline test.

That places the case in POL-NS-03, the wrong-entrance clause, which both advocates correctly identified as governing. The driver was stationary for 330 seconds — longer than the 300 s required — at a point 219.77 m from the pin: outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03 in exactly this situation, and POL-NS-05 does not bite either, because the 13:05:20 arrival marker sits at 219.77 m (under its 300 m trigger) with the driver at 0.0 km/h (under its 15 km/h trigger); POL-NS-05's own closing sentence sends this driver here. Under POL-NS-03 the driver did not arrive at the pickup point and the SGD 4.00 fee is refunded to the rider in full. POL-NS-06 points the same way, independently, on the zero in-geofence dwell.

Fault for the mislocation, which matters only for driver compensation, lies with the driver. The chat log shows the rider naming the correct tower twice — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — while the driver's only message places him at 'the mall taxi stand', and his own statement concedes he 'did not move to Tower B'. POL-NS-03(i) applies: the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation, so driver_compensation_sgd is null. This is not the pin-ambiguity case in POL-NS-03(ii), because the rider did specify the sub-location.

On the riders' POL-NS-04 claim, I accept the driver's answer to it, and it changes nothing: the rider's first locating message was sent at 13:05:05 and the driver replied at 13:06:00, fifty-five seconds later and inside the 120-second limit, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails and that clause does not apply. The rider's presence on the ground (25.01 m from the pin across all 16 qualifying fixes) is uncontested, but POL-NS-03's coordinate test does not turn on it. The driver's POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-05 submissions are accepted as correct statements of the coordinate test, and they are what carry the case to POL-NS-03 rather than to a non-attendance theory.

On evidence integrity, POL-NS-08 is not engaged. The trace has 34 fixes, 100% coverage and a maximum gap of 0.0 s; the arrived timestamp sits exactly on the 10 s fix grid and the cancellation time matches the last fix; the chat log's 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count with an unbroken msg_id sequence; and the SGD 4.00 fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so the fare line reconciles and no POL-NS-08(d) defect exists. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09105-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence is citable, but as both advocates note, POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable on a MISSING artifact, and it decides nothing here. This case is decided on the coordinate test alone.

On profiles and escalation, I accept both advocates' submissions. The only citable no-show fields are driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (1) against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (120) — a ratio of 0.008, far below the 4-or-more and greater-than-0.08 anti-farming test — and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d (0); rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0. The lifetime counters (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld) and the ratings are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as a ground of decision. No POL-NS-09 limb fires, confidence is above the 0.70 floor, and no referral clause (POL-RD-06(c), POL-RD-09(4), POL-NS-05(ii) or POL-NS-07) is triggered, so the referrals list is empty.

Confidence: every fact this ruling rests on — the driver's position and hold, and the chat allocation of fault — is carried by artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-09105, EV-TRIP-09105, EV-CHAT-09105), so the cap is 1.0 and I set confidence at 0.95.
